layout.body:
Discover Estonia's Timeless Charm
Nestled in northern Europe, Estonia blends cultural heritage with natural beauty, making it a captivating destination.
Its crown jewel, Tallinn's medieval Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage site—invites visitors to wander cobblestone streets, admire historic buildings, and climb St. Olaf's Church for sweeping views.
Town Hall Square buzzes with markets, offering a glimpse of vibrant local life.
Just outside the capital, Lahemaa National Park showcases misty forests, tranquil bogs, and pristine coastlines. Adventurers can explore scenic trails and spot wildlife like moose and lynx.
Off the coast, Kihnu Island preserves age-old traditions, where locals wear folk attire and celebrate with music and festivals, offering an authentic cultural experience.
English is widely spoken, but learning a few Estonian phrases will enrich your journey.
With its long daylight hours and mild weather, summer is the ideal season to explore Estonia's enchanting landscapes and living history.

questions.stem: What makes Tallinn's Old Town a significant attraction in Estonia?

options.A: It is recognized by UNESCO for its old architecture.
options.B: It features the largest central square in northern Europe.
options.C: It is famous for its art museums.
options.D: It is an area where locals wear traditional attire.

questions.analysis: What makes Tallinn's Old Town a significant attraction in Estonia? 原文依据：Tallinn's medieval Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage site 翻译：塔林中世纪老城是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。 选项分析： (A) It is recognized by UNESCO for its old architecture 古老建筑被联合国教科文组织认证 → 正确，原文直接对应 (B) It features the largest central square in northern Europe 拥有北欧最大中心广场 → 错误，文中无 “最大” 表述 (C) It is famous for its art museums 以艺术博物馆闻名 → 错误，全文未提及艺术博物馆 (D) It is an area where locals wear traditional attire 居民穿着传统服饰 → 错误，该内容属于基努岛，非老城

questions.stem: Which kind of tourist would most likely be attracted to Lahemaa National Park?

options.A: One who enjoys meeting local people
options.B: One who likes to hike in nature
options.C: One who wants to learn about Estonian history
options.D: One who is interested in Estonian folk customs

questions.analysis: Which kind of tourist would most likely be attracted to Lahemaa National Park? 原文依据：Adventurers can explore scenic trails and spot wildlife. 翻译：游客可以游览自然风光步道、观赏野生动物。 选项分析： (A) One who enjoys meeting local people 喜欢结识当地人 → 错误，不属于公园特色 (B) One who likes to hike in nature 喜爱户外自然徒步 → 正确，scenic trails 对应徒步活动 (C) One who wants to learn about Estonian history 想要了解历史 → 错误，历史景点为老城 (D) One who is interested in Estonian folk customs 对民俗文化感兴趣 → 错误，民俗对应海岛

questions.stem: According to the article, you can make your travel experience more rewarding by

options.A: attending a service at St. Olaf's Church
options.C: learning to speak some words in the local language
options.D: sampling the local cuisine at one of the markets

questions.analysis: According to the article, you can make your travel experience more rewarding by 原文依据：learning a few Estonian phrases will enrich your journey. 翻译：学习一些爱沙尼亚语短句，会让旅行更加丰富有意义。 选项分析： (A) attending a service at St. Olaf's Church 参加教堂礼拜 → 错误，仅可登高观景 (B) making friends with town residents 和当地居民交友 → 错误，原文无相关内容 (C) learning to speak some words in the local language 学习当地语言 → 正确，enrich your journey 对应提升旅行体验 (D) sampling the local cuisine at one of the markets 品尝当地美食 → 错误，文中未提及美食相关作用
